_why: THE RUNS PAYLOAD, pinned from both ends (round 66). `/api/operation` merges two feeds — terminal events and browser actions — onto ONE row shape, and the panel groups rows into runs, plans and goals by reading these fields. THE DEVICE'S MAPPING IS AN ALLOWLIST and says so in its own comment: 'a field missing here is dropped silently with every other test still green'. `run_id` was the first field to make that trip and it got a test of its own; this file is the same contract for ALL of them, on BOTH feeds, which is why there are two key lists and two `required_by_panel` lists rather than one.
_shape: read off agent/src/operation.rs (terminal_row, browser_row) — the mappings are pure functions since round 66 so this can be asserted without a data dir
_read_but_not_promised: The panel's row parser asks every row for `text` and `status`; the BROWSER feed does not carry them, and its own default turns the `undefined` into null. That is a deliberate shape, not an omission — adding them to the device would be a behaviour change dressed as a refactor, and a row parser that needed them for a browser row would be reading a fact no feed promises.
